servicesLede: Clear, upfront rates, straight from our price list. Pick what you need and send it over — we’ll come back with dates.

services.name: Portraits & headshots
services.desc: Guided outdoor or environmental session, 45–90 minutes, multiple outfit changes where applicable, custom gallery, high-resolution downloads with full personal-use rights. Delivery in 5–7 business days.

services.name: Events & celebrations
services.desc: Hourly documentary-style coverage of corporate functions, private parties and community gatherings — true-to-life colors, an organized online gallery to share and download. Delivery in 1–2 weeks.

services.name: Weddings & special milestones
services.desc: Pre-event consultation, dual-coverage options, high-resolution edited gallery, print release, private online client gallery. Base packages by hours of coverage. Full gallery in 3–5 weeks.

services.name: Commercial, pet & lifestyle
services.desc: Local businesses, product lifestyle, automotive and pet portraits. Pre-session planning, flexible locations, commercial usage licensing, files formatted for print, web or social. Custom quotes; delivery in 5–10 business days.

services.name: Real estate photography
services.desc: Crisp, well-lit interior and exterior shots that present the layout, space and detail without distorted wide angles or unnatural color shifts. Natural lighting balance, standard correction, MLS-ready delivery. Scaled by square footage.

services.name: Drone add-on
services.desc: True-to-life aerial exteriors showing the full property line, neighborhood, roof and acreage — no sky replacements, no fake grass. Add-on $100–$125; stand-alone session $150–$250.

services.name: Aerial real estate & land
services.desc: Residential lots, commercial buildings or multi-acre properties from multiple angles, heights and boundary perspectives. Custom quotes by acreage and location.

services.name: Roof & property inspection
services.desc: Close-up, multi-angle aerial imagery of shingles, gutters, chimneys, siding and overall condition — no scaffolding, no ladders. Organized photo documentation.

services.name: Surveying & mapping support
services.desc: High-altitude orthomosaic-style imagery for site progress, property boundaries and land assessment; weekly or monthly progress shoots available. Project-based pricing. For visual planning and inspection — official boundary surveys need a licensed state land surveyor.

_booking: If they already use a booking platform, put its link here and the Request button sends people there instead of composing a text.
about:
At Gilman Visual Media, we believe the most powerful images are the ones that reflect real life. In a world full of heavy filters and over-processed edits, our focus is simple: deliver clean, authentic, and timeless photography that captures genuine moments as they actually happen.

We specialize in realistic, raw storytelling. Whether we are covering events, portraits, commercial work, or life’s natural milestones, our goal isn’t to reshape reality — it’s to preserve it. We keep our editing intentional and minimal, allowing natural light, true colors, and honest emotion to take center stage.
points: No hidden fees — clear, upfront rates, high-resolution files in every package
Easy digital delivery — a personal, password-protected online gallery to view, download and share
True-to-life quality — clean color balance and lighting corrections that keep images natural
Complete ownership — full personal print releases, so you can print, share and save anywhere
FAA-certified, fully insured drone operations with 4K and RAW imaging
ctaHeading: Every great project starts with a simple conversation.
ctaLede: Whether you’re ready to book, have a few questions about how we work, or just want to share your ideas, send us a message. We’re always here to help and look forward to connecting with you.
